labels._title: Eureka service consumer updating the service list (Update) sequence diagram
labels._desc: Sequence diagram: DiscoveryClient calls initScheduledTasks and run starts CacheRefreshThread, which calls refreshRegistry on DiscoveryClient, which calls fetchRegistry and getAndUpdateDelta on itself, then getDelta through EurekaHttpClientDecorator to AbstractJerseyEurekaHttpClient, which calls getDelta and getApplicationsInternal.
